"notes": "- Implementation steps: (1) Define DtmfSentInfo struct and SentDtmfError enum in src/api/m20_dtmfsent_twophase.rs (2) Add DTMF_SENT_TIMEOUT_MS constant (3) Write #[cfg(test)] module with all 19 UT tests (4) Verify cargo test passes (5) Run cargo clippy and cargo fmt
- Risks: The src/api/ directory has no mod.rs and is not declared in lib.rs — the implementation file may need to be relocated to src/state/ following P1-2 convention, or a mod.rs must be created for api/
- Caveats: DtmfMethod import resolution depends on whether DtmfMethod gets its canonical definition elsewhere (P0-7/N0028). Current use of command_serialization::DtmfMethod is a stub that may be replaced.
- Open items: Whether P1-3 should also add SipEventPayload::DtmfSent variant (currently deferred to P5-1 event_model_payload_bus.rs). The conversion function from NativeEvent::DtmfDigit currently returns DtmfReceived, not DtmfSent — these are separate events.
- Future improvements: When P5-1 ships, DtmfSentInfo becomes a payload struct for SipEventPayload::DtmfSent variant. When P0-5 reactor ships, the 500ms timeout timer and DtmfSent event emission are wired in. When FFI bindings exist, SentDtmfError::PjsipError uses real pj_status_t.
Implementation summary:
- Added: src/state/m20_dtmfsent_twophase.rs (359 lines)
- Modified: src/state/mod.rs (added module declaration)
- Modified: src/api/m20_dtmfsent_twophase.rs (resolved STUB, redirected to new location)
- Key types: DtmfSentInfo (pub(crate) struct), SentDtmfError (pub(crate) enum), DTMF_SENT_TIMEOUT_MS (pub(crate) const)
- Traits: DtmfSentInfo: Debug+Clone, SentDtmfError: Debug+Clone+PartialEq+Eq
- Tests: 12 passing, covering all C030 contract elements (precondition/postcondition/invariant)
- Verification: cargo check --all-targets clean, cargo test --lib 142/142 passed, quality check 0 issues
Review report:
- Static quality check: passed
- Translatability: no issues — all names are domain concepts (method, digit, status, pjsip_status), no generic names
- Dependencies: consistency verified — uses existing DtmfMethod from command_serialization, SipError from error module
- Crime scan: 0 crimes (clean)
- STUB evaluation: 0 stubs in new code; 321 P1-3 stubs resolved, 146 stubs deferred to respective tickets
- #[allow(dead_code)] properly annotated with [::STUB::] P0-5 reference
- Issues found and applied: 2 quality fix (renamed 'a' to 'dtmf_sent', replaced .expect() with match), 2 test unused var prefix fix",
